a: अभिनंद् — {c1c} P. (rarely Ā.) 1 (a) To rejoice at or in, exult over, be glad or satisfied; आत्मविडंबनामभिनंदंति K. 108; Dk. 75. (b) To celebrate (with {{rejocings->rejoicings||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}} &c.); महोत्सवेन मज्जन्माभिनंदितवान् K. 137; नाभिनंदति न द्वेष्टि Bg. 2. 57. --2 To congratulate, hail with joy, welcome, greet; एनां परिष्वज्य तातकाश्यपेनैवं अभिनंदितं Ś. 4; तापसीभिरभिनंद्यमाना शकुंतला तिष्ठति ibid., 5, 6, 7; अभिनंदितागमेनषु समीरेषु K. 49, 63; अभिनंद्य ब्रवीति Mv. 2 says (writes) after compliments; R. 2. 74, 3. 68, 7. 69, 71; 30; 16. 64; 17. 15, 60; Y. 1. 332. --3 To rejoice at, approve, praise, applaud, commend; यो रत्नराशीनपि विहाय अभिनंद्यते Ś. 2; अतस्ते वचो नाभिनंदामि ibid. do not approve; तद्युक्तमस्या अभिलाषोऽभिनंदितुं Ś. 3; श्रूयंते परिणीतास्ताः (कन्यकाः) पितृभिश्चाभिनंदिताः 3. 24; नाम यस्याभिनंदंति द्विषोपि स पुमान्पुमान् Ki. 11. 73; 4. 4; with न reject; R. 12. 35. --4 To care for, like, desire or wish for, respect, delight in (usually with न in this sense); नाभिनंदति केलिकलाः Māl. 3; नाहारमभिनंदति K. 61; Dk. 159; आर्यपुत्रस्यैव मनोरथंसपत्तिमभिनंदामि Ve. 2 wish or desire; नाभिनंदेत मरणं नाभिनंदेत जीवितं Ms. 6. 45, H. 4. 4. --5 To bless, grant success to; U. 5. 28. --Caus. To gladden, delight.

अभिनंद — a. That which delights, encourages, praises &c. --दः 1 Rejoicing, delighting, joy, delight. --2 Praising, applauding, approving, greeting, congratulating. --3 Wish, desire. --4 Encouraging, inciting to action. --5 Very little happiness (सुखलव). --6 An epithet of परमात्मन् the Supreme Being. --दा Delight; wish, desire.
अभिनंदनीय --नंद्य — pot. p. To be rejoiced at, praised, or applauded; काममेतदभिनंदनीयं Ś. 5; R. 5. 31.

अभिनंदिन् — a. (At the end of comp.) Rejoicing at, approving, praising &c.

a: अभिनयः — 1 Acting, gesticulation, any theatrical action (expressive of some sentiment, passion &c. by look, gesture, posture &c.); नृत्याभिनयक्रियाच्युतं Ku. 5. 79; अभिनयान् परिचेतुमिवोद्यता R. 9. 33; नर्तकीरभिनयातिलंघिनीः 19. 14; Ki. 10. 42. --2 Dramatic representation, exhibition on the stage; ललिताभिनयं तमद्य भर्ता मरुतां द्रष्टुमनाः सलोकपालः V. 2. 18. S. D. thus defines and classifies अभिनयः-भवेदभिनयोऽवस्थानुकारः स चतुर्विधः . अंगिको वाचिकश्चैवमाहार्यः सात्त्विकस्तथा .. 274, ‘acting is the imitation of condition’; it is of four kinds:-- (1) gestural, conveyed by bodily actions; (2) vocal, conveyed by words; (3) extraneous, conveyed by dress, ornaments, decoration &c.; (4) internal, conveyed by the manifestation of internal feelings such as perspiration, thrilling &c. --Comp. --आचार्यः a dancing preceptor M. 1. 10. --विद्या science of acting or dramatic representation, art of dancing; मया तीर्थादभिनयविद्याशिक्षिता M. 1.

m: अभि-निवेश m. application, intentness, study, affection, devotion (with loc. or ifc.)
determination (to effect a purpose or attain an object), tenacity, adherence to (loc.), Kum. v, 7, &c.
a: अभिनिवेशः — 1 (a) Devotion, attachment, intentness, being occupied with, adherence to, close application, with loc. or in comp.; कतमस्मिंस्ते भावाभिनिवेशः V. 3; अहो निरर्थकव्यापारेष्वभिनिवेशः K. 120, 146, Dk. 81; Māl. 7. (b) Firm attachment, love, fondness, affection; बलीयान् खलु मेऽभिनिवेशः Ś. 3; अनुरूपोऽस्या ˚शः ibid., V. 2; असत्यभूते वस्तुन्यभिनिवेशः Mit. --2 Earnest desire, ardent longing or expectation; wish, desire; Māl. 5. 27. --3 Resolution, determined resolve, determination of purpose, firmness of resolve, perseverance; जनकात्मजायां नितांतरूक्षाभिनिवेशमीशं R. 14. 43; अनुरूप˚ शतोषिणा Ku. 5. 7; Śi. 3. 1. (b) Idea, thought; Ms. 12. 5; Y. 3. 155. --4 (In Yoga phil.) A sort of ignorance causing fear of death; instinctive clinging to worldly life and bodily enjoyments and the fear that one might be cut off from all of them by death; अविद्याऽ स्मितारागद्वेषाभिनिवेशाः पंचक्लेशाः Yoga S.; cf. also Sāṅ. K. 150 and Malli. on Śi. 4. 55.
